'''Horos''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> that was located in the [[Horos system/Legends|Horos system]], a part of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Horos Spine]]. During the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]]&mdash;fought from [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]] to [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] between the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], the group of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and being under the influence of<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], the Aqualish [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="CSWE Ando">{{CSWECite|I|30|Ando}}</ref> and<ref name="EGTW" /> the fifteen Aqualish-settled planets known as the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|30|Andosha II}}</ref>&mdash;the forces of the Spiverelda defeated those of the Free Colonies at a [[Battle of Horos|confrontation]] at Horos.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horos was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Horos [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the astronomical object itself, in grid square Q-15.<ref name="TEA" />
